core-spacing-0.$description: Core step, 0 px. Nothing. Use it deliberately — a zero gap should be a decision, not an omission.  ·  Do not use directly — reference a semantic spacing token.

semantic-layout-gutter-page.$description: Page left and right margin. Web 48; back office 24 from the 220px sidebar edge; mobile 24.
